description: Per-engine capability profile used by backend/app/recommend.py to pick a suggested image-generation engine for a given scene (F9/F17/F18). Scores are 1-5, relative judgement calls based on observed output quality on this stack - not a benchmark. Safe to hand-tune as real usage reveals better/worse fits; bump 'version' on any scoring change so stored recommendations can be told apart from ones made under an older profile.

flux_schnell.notes: Fastest engine (4 sampling steps). No negative-prompt input, so it has no way to steer away from anatomy problems once they start - best for simple/generic scenes, worst pick for contorted-hand feedback.

sdxl_adetailer.notes: Runs an automatic face/hand detection + inpaint pass after the base image, built specifically to fix contorted limbs and hands. Best default for scenes with multiple characters or close-up figures, and the top recommendation whenever feedback mentions anatomy.

qwen_image_2512.notes: Sharpest detail and the only engine that reliably renders legible in-image text (signs, letters, book pages). Slowest engine (6-9 min/image even with the Lightning LoRA) - reserve it for complex or text-heavy scenes rather than using it by default.
